comments.body: LIVE-CHECK ATTESTATION (dogfood, 2026-07-13): the deployed auto-lander landed a REAL single-change stack end-to-end on main — change #618 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/618), status MERGED, submitter 'Rebar Bot Nava' (the bot, not a human). Flow: Autosubmit+1 was set and the agent walked away; the bot selected it, main advanced under it, so it rebased to a fresh Patch Set 3, awaited a fresh Verified+1 on the rebased tree, and ancestor-atomic-submitted the exact tested SHA -> merged. This exercised the full R5-preserving await-fresh-Verified + submit path against the live Gerrit 3.14.1 instance. Fresh-Verified-per-member await + ancestor-atomic submit proven live (PS3 earned a fresh Verified+1 before submit; single tip submit -> MERGED).

compiled_state.description:
## Why
The landing action itself: wait for CI to re-verify the rebased tree (every chain member) and submit the tip atomically so the tested tree is exactly the merged tree (the R5 gate invariant). Split out of S2 (`perovskite-frilly-grebe`).

## Files
- `infra/autolander/loop.py` — fresh-Verified await + ancestor-atomic submit.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] **Fresh Verified (per member):** a `Verified +1` on the exact rebased patchset SHA (not a copied/carried vote). **For a multi-member chain, `rebase:chain` mints a NEW patchset (distinct SHA) per member, so ALL members must carry a fresh `Verified +1` on their own post-rebase SHAs before submit** — submitting while any member lacks a fresh Verified would land an untested tree (violates R5).
- [ ] **Bounded await:** await fresh Verified up to a bounded timeout (default 30 min, configurable, matching `land`'s timeout); on timeout (CI hung), hand the stack back (S2b mechanism) rather than blocking forever. (`LLM-Review` carries `TRIVIAL_REBASE`/`MERGE_FIRST_PARENT_UPDATE` per ADR-0041; `Verified` re-runs on each new patchset.)
- [ ] **Ancestor-atomic submit** = a single `POST /changes/{tip-id}/submit` on the chain tip. Gerrit submits the chain's members **"Submitted Together"** by relation-chain ancestry (all-or-nothing), reinforced by the **shared topic S3 assigns to the stack** (`stack_id` = the Gerrit topic) with `change.submitWholeTopic` active on this instance. **Partial-land safety (mandatory):** after the submit call, the loop MUST verify **every** stack member reached `MERGED`; if any member is left `open` (a partial land — e.g. members not grouped as expected), it fails LOUDLY (`AUTOLANDER_ERROR` + metric) and hands the stack back rather than proceeding, upholding R3/R5. On full-merge success, close/annotate the associated ticket(s) via `import rebar` ticket ops.
- [ ] **Tests:** unit-test the all-members-fresh rule (submit blocked if any member's SHA lacks a fresh Verified), the bounded-await timeout → hand-back, the **partial-land detection** (a member left `open` after submit → loud error + hand-back), and the **ticket close/annotate on merge** (`import rebar` called with the right ids).
- [ ] [operator-attested] a live check lands one real single-change stack end-to-end (a live run against the deployed Gerrit auto-lander, not a unit test).
